overview_description.description: Klarna is a global digital bank and flexible payments provider. With over 114 million global active Klarna users and 3.4 million transactions per day, Klarna’s AI-powered payments and commerce network is empowering people to pay smarter with a mission to be available everywhere for everything. Consumers can pay with Klarna online, in-store and through Apple Pay & Google Pay. More than 850,000 retailers trust Klarna’s innovative solutions to drive growth and loyalty, including Uber, H&M, Saks, Sephora, Macy’s, Ikea, Expedia Group, Nike and Airbnb. Klarna is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: KLAR).

product.name: Klarna Payments
product.description: Flexible checkout and financing options that let shoppers pay immediately, later, in installments, or over multiple months, subject to market and eligibility requirements.

product.name: Klarna for Business
product.description: Merchant payment, checkout, customer acquisition, and marketing solutions designed to increase conversion, attract shoppers, and support online and in-store commerce.

product.name: Klarna App
product.description: A consumer finance and shopping application for managing Klarna payments, tracking spending, setting budgets, accessing payment methods, and receiving customer support.

product.name: Klarna Card
product.description: A Klarna payment card that lets eligible users pay in stores and online, including at merchants that accept Visa, while selecting available Klarna payment options.

product.name: Klarna Memberships
product.description: Paid subscription plans that provide eligible users with additional cashback opportunities, travel-related benefits, lifestyle benefits, and selected merchant offers.

product.name: Klarna Balance
product.description: A Klarna account balance that users can fund through the app and use for flexible payments and other supported Klarna transactions.
